reviews.title: Regret that I paid for the year
reviews.text:
Starting with the positives: this app has many of the wickets to create the positive self belief system to help achieve goals. It directs you with small tasks that lead you to become the person you desire to be. 
Negatives: the app simply isn’t ready for mainstream use. It feels like a beta version still in development. It bugs EVERY SINGLE TIME I use it. Every time. It deletes my “why,” “my future self” statement, tasks I’ve added, tasks I’ve edited…super frustrating. Sure, I could save those in my notes and upload them when one is deleted, but that defeats the purpose of the app. More importantly, it wastes time. I try to stay off my phone, I don’t need an app forcing me to stay on it longer. I give it 4 stars for vision, 2 stars for functionality, and 3 stars for overall design(still room for improvement) = 3 stars average score.

reviews.title: Building Discipline, Not Just Motivation
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app as part of my daily routine, and it’s honestly helped me stay more locked in with my goals. What I like most is that it’s not just about motivation — it’s about building real discipline and structure in your day. As someone who’s into fitness and self-improvement, I’m always trying to stay consistent, and this app makes it easier to track progress and stay accountable. It reminds me to stay focused on the bigger picture and not just rely on how I feel in the moment. I’ve started applying what I use in the app to other areas of my life too — whether it’s workouts, content creation, or just staying productive throughout the day. It’s helped me stay more intentional with how I move and how I plan my days. It’s not something that magically changes everything overnight, but if you actually use it and stay consistent, it can definitely help you stay on track and build better habits over time.

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the “Future Self” app, and it’s honestly such a unique and motivating experience. The concept of writing messages to your future self really helps with setting goals, reflecting on life, and staying accountable. It feels like a personal time capsule that you can open later and see how far you’ve come.

The interface is simple and easy to use, which makes the whole experience even better. I love how it encourages positivity and self-growth without feeling overwhelming. It’s perfect for anyone who wants to stay inspired, track personal progress, or just leave little reminders for themselves.

Overall, it’s a thoughtful and meaningful app that adds value to your daily routine. Definitely worth trying!

reviews.title: ⭐️ 1 Star! Disappointing experience and misleading subscription
reviews.text: The app starts with a very polished and motivating introduction, which makes you believe you’ll be able to try the app and see real value before committing. Unfortunately, that’s not the case. Very quickly, you’re pushed into a 1 year subscription with no real free trial or meaningful way to test the app first. After using it for about a week, I found that the content is extremely basic. The app mainly reminds you to write down your thoughts like a simple journal, drink water, and go for a run. There’s nothing unique or advanced here, and everything it offers can easily be done for free using the Notes app and basic reminders on your phone. When I realized the app wasn’t for me, I contacted customer support to cancel the subscription. Despite explaining that I had only used the app for a short time, I was told that cancellation was not possible. This made the whole experience feel frustrating and unfair. Overall, the value does not justify the price, and the subscription model feels misleading. I wouldn’t recommend this app to anyone looking for something genuinely helpful or worth the money!
